{{Youmay|the settlement|[[Rhigar/Legends|Rhigar]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]}}
'''Rhigar''' was a small settlement that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. It was inhabited by [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]] and the main conduit into it was [[Bridge 242]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the village was abandoned by its civilian population and the buildings in it were reduced to rubble by bombing.
